newsitem.title: USA: CAPSTONE OPERATING INCOME AT NEW HIGH.
newsitem.headline: CAPSTONE OPERATING INCOME AT NEW HIGH.

text.p: Capstone Pharmacy Services Inc Tuesday reported record operating income in the second quarter on a 221 percent increase in revenues to $77.5 million.
It said operating income, exclusive of merger related expenses, was $6.8 million for the latest quarter as compared to $834,396 for the second quarter of 1996.

During the second quarter the company recognized $1,659,017 of expenses associated with its pending combination with Pharmacy Corp of America, saying these "are in line with our estimates of these expenses."
Net income for the quarter, exclusive of the merger related expenses, was $3.3 million, or $0.09 per share, compared to $492,635, or $0.03 per share.
Chairman Allan Silber said "we have made substantial progress in developing a detailed plan for the integration of our operations with those of Pharmacy Corporation of America.

"We remain an active acquirer of institutional pharmacy operations as evidenced by our most recently announced agreement to acquire the operations of Med-Tec Pharmaceutical Services, which will add approximately $13 million in annualized revenue." ((-- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610))
